children: Helmerich & Payne Inc. (HP) filed a Form 8K - Other Events - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 16, 2026.

The Directors of Helmerich & Payne, Inc. (the "Company"), at a Board of Directors meeting held on September 16, 2026, declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.25 per share on the Company's common stock, payable on December 2, 2026, to stockholders of record at the close of business November 18, 2026.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/46765/000004676526000044/hp-20260916.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/46765/000004676526000044/0000046765-26-000044-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
